states.name: boil water kettle
states.definition: Filling the kettle with water, placing it on the base, and turning it on to heat the water.

states.name: grind coffee beans
states.definition: Opening the coffee bag, scooping or pouring beans into the grinder, and operating the grinder.

states.name: assemble coffee filter
states.definition: Rinsing, positioning, and stacking the V60 metal filter on top of the coffee jug and transferring ground coffee into it.

states.name: pour hot water
states.definition: Pouring hot water from the kettle into the V60 filter in circles to soak and brew the coffee grounds.

states.name: wash coffee utensils
states.definition: Washing and rinsing coffee cups, jug, spoon, and filter by hand in the sink.
